name: personal-assistant-platform
//zod-split: The monorepo runs TWO zod majors ON PURPOSE. 10 packages pin zod@^3.24.0 and their TS SOURCE is written against zod@3's type API — forcing them onto zod@4 breaks `tsc` (core-types: ZodDefault<ZodObject> overload errors) and fails the predeploy gate. Separately the @openai/agents* SDK declares zod@^4 as a PEER and crashes at LOAD on zod@3 (`reading 'type'` in zod/v3/types.cjs). REINSTALL RECIPE — use --force, NOT --legacy-peer-deps: `rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install --force`. --force ignores the genuine cross-workspace ERESOLVE (openai 4 vs 6) AND still materializes peers + per-package nesting, producing the correct split: top-level zod@4.3.6 (the @openai/agents* peers resolve it → no crash) + a nested zod@3.25.76 under each v3-pinned workspace (core-types/pa-orchestrator/shared-tags/pa-resume-parser/pa-connectors → their tsc resolves v3). --legacy-peer-deps SKIPS peer materialization so agents-core falls back to whatever zod is hoisted and crashes; a global `overrides:{zod:4}` breaks the v3 packages' tsc. The nested overrides below pin the agents' zod to exactly 4.3.6. Verify after install: `node -e "require('./packages/core-types/node_modules/zod/package.json')"` is 3.x AND top-level zod is 4.3.6.

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build --workspace=@pa/dashboard-web
scripts.build:all:prod: npm run build && npm run build:dashboard:with-injected-env
scripts.test: node --test tests/scenarios/runner.test.mjs && node scripts/run-scenarios-if-env.mjs && npm run test -ws --if-present
scripts.test:voice: cd apps/eval/voice && PA_RUN_EVAL=1 deepeval test run test_voice_baseline.py -n 4
scripts.test:voice:anchors: cd apps/eval/voice && PA_RUN_EVAL=1 deepeval test run test_voice_baseline.py -k regression-anchor
